svg.title: Make a Leafy Friend — step 5: Meet your leafy friend
svg.desc: Give your creation a name and a personality. Add a leaf hat or a little leafy home if you like. Take a picture before moving it; the loose version is meant to stay flat.

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Name it. Change it. Remember it.
